title: A source observation recorded after a run's completion opens no obligation on the completed run
outcome: A source observation recorded after a run's completion opens no obligation on the completed run
acceptance: A regression reproduces completion sealed then a source-changing checkpoint from the same begun session, including mixed typed evidence and exact replay: original seal bytes and acceptance links remain unchanged, no new obligation or root contribution appears, receipt ids replay exactly, and the grant closes. Active-run observations still open required obligations; observations preceding completion still gate it; evidence is never rebound to a later focus or run.

After this fix, a valid begun-grant checkpoint targeting a completed or sealed run retains its late execution observation, truthful source-change metadata, original grant/run binding, receipt and grant closure, while opening no new mutation obligation; show and core inspect expose no newly opened obligation for that checkpoint.

The execution-observation and mixed typed verification/environment writers share one completed-run lifecycle decision: late records remain auditable outside the completion seal and neither reopen or satisfy run obligations nor change the sealed root's contributor or contribution accounting. Existing exact binding/source-root validation and whole-checkpoint atomicity remain enforced.

This changes future writes only. Existing canonical late observations and erroneously opened historical obligations remain readable as stored, with no deletion, hidden filtering, rewritten seal or implicit migration; any supported historical resolution is separately owned.

completion.summary: A host turn checkpointed after its run finished keeps its observations and evidence under the original binding but is audit only: no obligation opened or satisfied, no root contributor or contribution changed; WorkRun::is_finished decides it for writers and history readers. The obligation read and the doctor accept a source change after the completion cut with none or the full older-build set, staying strict before the cut and for an unreadable seal. The live stores held 23 such late changes (22 in Engram), each still checked in full; doctor healthy before and after on all 4 stores.
